metadata.description: Canonical dedup/normalization prompt (GraphRAG pipeline stage 4). Single source of truth for knowledge_graph.distillation.deduplicator.KnowledgeDeduplicator.merge_cluster's merge prompt. Substitute $blocks with the newline-joined 'Block N:\n  Question: ..\n  Answer: ..' summaries.

identity.goal: Merge overlapping knowledge blocks into one canonical block with no information loss.

instructions.core_directive:
You are merging overlapping knowledge blocks into a single canonical block. Preserve all unique information while eliminating redundancy. Return a JSON object with exactly these keys:
  "name": a concise descriptive title,
  "critical_question": the unified question this knowledge answers,
  "trusted_answer": the validated, comprehensive answer (2-4 sentences),
  "tags": a list of classification tags,
  "keywords": a list of retrieval keywords

Blocks to merge:
$blocks
